title: PHP security team on oss-security, 22 October 09:11 UTC: the 'incomplete fix' report is 'unrelated' and 'has nothing to do with the RCE'
description: Jakub Zelenka (who published both advisories) answering Rainbolt's relay of the Fediverse report. This is PHP's public answer that the site's front page says does not exist.
